name: archimedes-plugins

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: Band above the prompt, 3 rows: goal, clock and time left; the file in use and the advisor count; a cell meter colored by state

plugins.name: agents-pane
plugins.description: Side pane of agents and files: a lane per agent colored by role, with tokens, cost, the files it touches and their diffs

plugins.name: advisor-watch
plugins.description: Counts advisor calls; /advisor-stats shows the session and all-time counts

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Band that warns before the prompt cache goes cold and says how much the next message re-reads

description: Claude Code mods that show what Claude does now: progress, agents, files, advisor calls, cache
